blocks.raw: <Tip>**Memory rule:** Dormitory = Group **B** (transient residential, not A). Never confuse with permanent multi-family (A-2). DOT star ratings: 1★=16, 2★=20, 3★=25, 4★=30, 5★=40 sqm. Occupant load formula: sleeping area sqm ÷ 9.3 = occupants (then add common areas separately for total design capacity).</Tip>
